component.name: Kalliope
component.summary: Type, and be heard in video calls
Scrivi e fatti sentire nelle videochiamate

description.p: Kalliope is for people who cannot speak, or find speaking hard. Type during a video call, and Kalliope says it aloud with a natural voice. The voice goes into a virtual microphone that Zoom, Teams, Meet, Jitsi and other call apps can select.

Kalliope è per chi non può parlare o fa fatica a farlo. Scrivi durante una videochiamata e Kalliope lo dice ad alta voce, con una voce naturale. La voce entra in un microfono virtuale che Zoom, Teams, Meet, Jitsi e le altre app per chiamate possono scegliere.

ul.li: The voice is made on your computer, with the voice models that come with Kalliope: nothing is downloaded.
Numbers, dates, times, money, abbreviations and chat shorthand are read the way people say them.
Punctuation shapes the voice: questions sound like questions, and commas make pauses.
La voce è creata sul tuo computer, con i modelli che arrivano con Kalliope: non si scarica niente.
Numeri, date, orari, importi, abbreviazioni e sigle da chat sono letti come li direbbe una persona.
La punteggiatura dà forma alla voce: le domande suonano come domande e le virgole fanno pause.

description.p: The window speaks the language of the system: the 24 languages of the European Union, and Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, Bengali, Indonesian and Urdu, with the window mirrored for Arabic and Urdu and a typeface for each script. The voices still speak Italian only. The window fits small screens and remembers where it was, the words light up when they are heard, and Kalliope ends when its window is destroyed.

A new window made for writing: a large writing area where Enter speaks, the words lighting up as the voice says them, and the phrases said kept across restarts. Kalliope tells you when nobody in the call hears you. Create your own voice inside Kalliope, by recording yourself or from an old voice message or video. A compact meeting mode, adjustable text size, and light and dark themes that follow the system.

The window follows the GNOME or Plasma desktop style. Start typing while the voice loads, and scroll to repeat earlier phrases in compact windows. Preparing a personal voice creates the voices folder on first use.

ul.li: The Kalliope window: type, press Enter, and Kalliope speaks, with Giulia or Marco.
A virtual microphone called “Kalliope” (with PipeWire), to choose in Zoom, Teams, Meet, Jitsi or the browser.
The voices are made on your computer and come inside the package: Kalliope downloads nothing and works without internet.
A first step towards the voice of the person who uses Kalliope: a voice imitated from a recording, which for now is prepared from a terminal with kalliope-cli and then offered by the window.
Italian read the way people say it: numbers, dates, money, abbreviations and chat shorthand become words.
